===========
Bluetooth LE SoC Tool
===========

The Bluetooth LE SoC Tool provides a toolkit for development on the host, used for extending functionality development, user application development, or mass production. This document briefly introduces these tools and their usage. For user manuals of each tool, please refer to the tool user manual in the specific directory.
Here is a summary of the tools described:

.. csv-table:: Brief Description of Tools
   :header: File Name, Description, WINDOWS, LINUX, MACOS
   :stub-columns: 1
   :align: center
   :name: Tool Description

   :Doc:`Bee MP Tool<mptool/text_en/README>`, "Used for R&D debugging or mass production.", √, , 
   :Doc:`MPCli Tool<mpcli/text_en/README>`, "Commond-line version of Bee MP Tool, which used for R&D debugging or mass production.", √, √, √
   :Doc:`Flash Map Generate Tool<flashmaptool/text_en/README>`, "Used to generate ``flashmap.ini``, ``flashmap.h``, ``OTAHeader`` files.", √, ,
   :Doc:`MP Pack Tool<packtool/text_en/README>`, "Used to merge image files and generate data packet files for :term:`MP`, :term:`OTA`, :term:`CFU`\ .", √, ,
   :Doc:`PackCli Tool<packcli/text_en/README>`, "Commond-line version of MP Pack Tool, Used to merge image files and generate data packet files for :term:`MP`, :term:`OTA`, :term:`CFU`\ .", √, √, √
   :Doc:`RF Test Tool<rftesttool/text_en/README>`, "Used for Bluetooth, Zigbee, and other RF performance testing and certification testing such as :term:`FCC`, :term:`BQB`, :term:`CE`, :term:`SRRC`, :term:`KC`\ .", √, , 
   :Doc:`Font Convert Tool<font convert tool/text_en/README>`, "Used to convert vector font data to bitmap, output as a ``.bin`` file.", √, ,
   :Doc:`Image Convert Tool<image convert tool/text_en/README>`, "Used to convert the image files according to the set parameters, output the respective image ``.bin`` files, and package the converted ``.bin`` files.", √, ,
